title: 函館スプリントSの後に・カワイイ魅力

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I ran well… right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I ran well… right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I was super cute, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I figured. But I feel like something's missing. I feel like I didn't steal everyone's hearts…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I dunno why. Is being cute not enough? No… Cuteness is all-powerful. Then…
Curren Chan gets lost in her thoughts. I think she's doing great, personally, but…
Even on the way back to Tokyo, Curren Chan goes through bouts of silence.
I decide to leave her be, so I scroll through social media and find…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hm? Umatter?
choice_data_list: There are a bunch of posts about the race.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: "I saw Curren run for the first time. Turns out sprints are pretty cool." "I'm gonna keep an eye on her." "#CuteCurrenChan"…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Wow… So more people are getting into sprints. It's not happening very fast, but I'm glad…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Oh…

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: This comment. "I couldn't keep my eyes off Curren Chan."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: "It all happened so fast, but the image of Curren Chan suddenly pulling out in front is still burned into my mind."…
choice_data_list: Yeah, that's how sprints are. Over in a flash.
Yeah, that's how sprints are. Over in a flash.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah, they are!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: You can't even blink. You just have to hold your breath and keep your eyes peeled. That's why I love sprints!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: All I need is a minute. In one minute, I can steal everyone's hearts. That's why they're so interesting!
Curren Chan's eyes light up. I think sprints really match her personality as well.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: …But I don't want to be an afterimage that fades once that minute ends. I want to be engraved in their hearts.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I want to be in everyone's hearts forever!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: …My next race is the Sprinters Stakes. I've gotta make sure I finish my homework by then.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I have to think… and figure out what I need to fill everyone's hearts with cuteness.
choice_data_list: Let's find it at summer camp!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: …Yeah!
The next race is our big goal—the Sprinters Stakes. Let's hope she can find what she needs at summer camp before then.
